command: set -eu; SERIAL=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}' | sed -n '1p'); XML=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cat /sdcard/auth.xml 2>/dev/null || true); if printf '%s' "$XML" | grep -q 'Connect Google account'; then B=$(printf '%s' "$XML" | python3 -c 'import sys,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET; r=ET.fromstring(sys.stdin.read()); n=next((x for x in r.iter() if x.attrib.get("text")=="Connect Google account"),None); print(n.attrib["bounds"] if n is not None else "")'); XY=$(printf '%s' "$B" | python3 -c 'import sys,re; a=list(map(int,re.findall(r"\d+",sys.stdin.read()))); print((a[0]+a[2])//2,(a[1]+a[3])//2)'); set -- $XY; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap "$1" "$2"; sleep 2; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/google.xml >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; G=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cat /sdcard/google.xml 2>/dev/null || true); if printf '%s' "$G" | grep -q 'meehow939@gmail.com'; then B2=$(printf '%s' "$G" | python3 -c 'import sys,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET; r=ET.fromstring(sys.stdin.read()); n=next((x for x in r.iter() if x.attrib.get("text")=="meehow939@gmail.com"),None); print(n.attrib["bounds"] if n is not None else "")'); XY2=$(printf '%s' "$B2" | python3 -c 'import sys,re; a=list(map(int,re.findall(r"\d+",sys.stdin.read()))); print((a[0]+a[2])//2,(a[1]+a[3])//2)'); set -- $XY2; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap "$1" "$2"; sleep 3; fi; fi; echo '--- TOP AFTER CONNECT ATTEMPT ---'; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys activity activities | grep -m1 'topResumedActivity' || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/postconnect.xml >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cat /sdcard/postconnect.xml 2>/dev/null | sed 's/></>\n</g' | grep -E 'meehow939|Drive file scope|Gmail send scope|Granted|Not granted|Connect Google account|Change Google account|Allow|Continue|Cancel' | head -180 || true
